newsitem.title: TURKEY: Trading in Garanti suspended in Istanbul.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Garanti suspended in Istanbul.

text.p: Istanbul's Stock Exchange said it had suspended trading in shares of Turkiye Garanti Bankasi AS, a leading Turkish bank, temporarily on Friday.
The Exchange said it had asked for a letter of explanation from the bank about a press report on Thursday.
Trading will resume when the explanation is received by the Exchange.
The Exchange did not specify which press report it was concerned about. But some brokers say it might be a report about the sale of Bank Ekspress, owned by Garanti's majority shareholder Dogus group.
Daily Yeni Yuzyil said accord was reached in talks for the sale of Bank Ekspres to contractror Korkmaz Yigit for $125 million. No immediate confirmation of the report is available.
